lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Solana just cracked the top 5 on CoinGecko — and it’s moving fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just a bubble, it’s a shift in how blockchain scales.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Solana is a high-speed blockchain that processes thousands of transactions per second.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its unique proof-of-history mechanism cuts down on confirmation times.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers and traders are jumping in — and the network is getting busier.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Solana’s speed is making it a serious competitor to Ethereum.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: If you’re not watching Solana, you might be missing the next big move — are you ready?
